author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 3: GAE Lambda Tuning (0.95)
abstract: This experiment begins the final phase of my PPO hyperparameter tuning. I am testing a lower GAE lambda of 0.95 (down from the baseline of 0.97). I hypothesize that this will reduce variance in the advantage estimates and may lead to more stable learning.
